note: Datasets used by scripts/training/. Raw files are local only (gitignored).

pose_coco2017_val_keypoints.name: COCO 2017 train+val, person keypoints (license-filtered subset)
pose_coco2017_val_keypoints.source: https://cocodataset.org (annotations_trainval2017.zip members person_keypoints_val2017.json + person_keypoints_train2017.json, fetched by HTTP range; images from images.cocodataset.org)
pose_coco2017_val_keypoints.publication: Lin et al., 'Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context', ECCV 2014
pose_coco2017_val_keypoints.license: Annotations: CC BY 4.0 (COCO Consortium). Images: owned by their Flickr authors; only license ids 4 (CC BY), 5 (CC BY-SA), 7 (no known copyright restrictions), 8 (US Government Work) kept. Local evaluation only, not redistributed.
pose_coco2017_val_keypoints.commercial_or_demo_use: Annotations: yes with attribution. Images: CC BY / BY-SA allow it with attribution; not redistributed here.
pose_coco2017_val_keypoints.subject_ids: none in COCO; split by image
pose_coco2017_val_keypoints.label_notes: 17 keypoints per person with visibility flag (0 not labelled, 1 labelled but occluded, 2 visible). No posture labels exist in COCO, so none are used.

voice_emozionalmente.name: Emozionalmente: a crowdsourced Italian speech emotional corpus
voice_emozionalmente.publication: F. Catania, J. W. Wilke, F. Garzotto, 'Emozionalmente: a crowdsourced Italian speech emotional corpus', IEEE/ACM TASLP 2025 (DOI 10.1109/TASLPRO.2025.3540662)
voice_emozionalmente.subject_ids: hashed actor ids; the official split is speaker-independent (verified: no speaker in two splits)
voice_emozionalmente.why_this_dataset: The app's model was trained on RAVDESS, TESS, CREMA-D and SAVEE, so those can't evaluate it fairly; this corpus is independent.
caveats: Italian speech; the model is English-trained
'neutral' has no equivalent in the model's labels

face_open_closed_eyes.name: Open and Closed Eyes Dataset (balanced random subset)
face_open_closed_eyes.publication: Dataset card only (Michał Młodawski, HF DOI 10.57967/hf/2745); no paper
face_open_closed_eyes.license: ODC-BY (Open Data Commons Attribution License), per the dataset card
face_open_closed_eyes.subject_ids: none: AI-generated faces; near-duplicates (dHash <= 4 bits) grouped so they never cross splits
face_open_closed_eyes.label_notes: open_eyes / closed_eyes from the generator, with eye bounding boxes; not human-verified
caveats: AI-generated images, not real webcam frames

not_used.FER-2013: no clear license; expression classification is outside Face Analysis by design

voice_crema_d_subset.name: CREMA-D (10-actor subset, 5 emotions) -- regression check only
voice_crema_d_subset.publication: Cao et al., 'CREMA-D: Crowd-sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset', IEEE Trans. Affective Computing 2014
voice_crema_d_subset.license: Open Database License 1.0; contents: Database Contents License 1.0 (LICENSE.txt in the repository)
voice_crema_d_subset.commercial_or_demo_use: allowed (ODbL share-alike applies to redistributed databases; nothing is redistributed here)
voice_crema_d_subset.subject_ids: actor ids in file names; 10 actors
voice_crema_d_subset.role: English regression check for the voice head only; NOT a fair baseline test (the production model was trained on CREMA-D)

considered_not_used.FER-2013: No clear license (web-scraped images; secondary sources disagree on CC BY vs CC BY-NC). Also out of scope: Face Analysis deliberately does not classify expressions.
considered_not_used.RAVDESS: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but it is in the production voice model's training data (model card), so it cannot evaluate it fairly.
considered_not_used.TESS: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (no derivatives) and in the production voice model's training data.
considered_not_used.SAVEE: In the production voice model's training data; access via registration.
considered_not_used.CREMA-D (as a test set): In the production voice model's training data; used only as an English regression check for the new head.
considered_not_used.MPII Human Pose: ~12 GB image archive for 16 keypoints; COCO keypoints cover the same points with a per-image license filter and small downloads.
considered_not_used.AffectNet / RAF-DB / CK+ / BIWI / AFLW20: Require registration, a signed agreement, or have non-commercial research-only terms with unclear derivative rights; not downloaded.
considered_not_used.eye-crop datasets (MRL Eye, CEW): Eye crops only (Face Landmarker needs whole faces) and/or unclear licenses.
